name: Lovedori
source:
Main character and his classmate attend a technical school. They enjoy each other and wait for graduation. However, that brings them to an unexpected results...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角與同班同學就讀技術學校。
兩人相處愉快，等著畢業。
然而，這將給他們帶來意料之外的結果……
